# Feature: AppNav match pause / resume

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Add a Pause / Resume control next to AppNav history so the player can freeze an active solo match (stop bot auto-play / LLM) while inspecting, opening settings, or navigating away — then resume normal flow.

Roadmap: ad-hoc UX (Stufe B) — Play session controls in shell.

## Preconditions

- App open with Vite + React shell
- Solo match started (board after setup / MatchIntro path with `GameState`)
- Heuristic or LLM bot enabled

## Happy Path

- [ ] On Play (setup or match), AppNav history cluster shows Zurück → Pause/Weiter → Vor (`data-testid="app-nav-pause"`); Pause is disabled until a match board exists
- [ ] Clicking Pause sets German label/tooltip to „Weiter“ (`data-testid="app-nav-resume"`) and shows a paused banner on the play board
- [ ] While paused, bot does not auto-play turns and LLM bot does not fire
- [ ] Resume restores bot auto-play on the bot’s turn
- [ ] Pause control is hidden outside Play (menu / forge / build); on Play setup without board it stays visible but disabled
- [ ] Navigation away (Forge/Build/Settings/Notes) remains possible while paused

## Edge Cases

- [ ] New play session / brand home remount clears paused state
- [ ] Playtest cheatbox „Bot pausieren“ stays in sync with the same pause flag
- [ ] Pause mid LLM request cancels in-flight bot turn (effect cleanup)

## Regression

- [ ] History back/forward still works
- [ ] Battle music / match intro flow unchanged
- [ ] `npm run build` green

## Assumptions

- Soft pause: stop auto bot + banner; human board clicks not hard-blocked (except combat modal — see `match-pause-freeze-combat.md`)
- Pause lives in App composition root; PlayView consumes `matchPaused`

## Implementation Notes

- Files touched: `src/App.tsx`, `src/features/shell/AppNav.tsx`, `src/features/play/PlayView.tsx`, `.qa/acceptance/app-nav-match-pause.md`
- Pause state owned by App composition root (`matchPaused` / `matchActive`); AppNav shows Pause/Weiter between history when `showMatchPause` (Play route); enabled only when `matchActive`; PlayView gates bot effect on `matchPaused` (all modes, not only playtest)
- Playtest cheatbox „Bot pausieren“ syncs via same `onMatchPausedChange`
- Banner: `data-testid="match-paused-banner"`; soft pause (bot stop only)
- Unit tests: none (UI + composition wiring); `npm run build` green
- Session reset: brand home remount clears pause via `resetPlaySession` (Play stays mounted across tab switches so match/setup survive confirmed leave)
